I replied to Ilse in our DM (DSHARED0002) to say I'd noted the new 7 July cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork and that it stays between us.

- **Not saved elsewhere:** I didn't write the cutoff to GBrain. GBrain is shared and other people can search it, so saving it there would break "keep it between us." The DM itself is the record.
- **No other action:** She said no action was needed, so I didn't send any mail, add a calendar entry or post in a channel.
- **GBrain check:** As your instructions require, I searched GBrain first. The Quarrendon pages were about seat counts and support tickets, with nothing that conflicts with the new date. The search ran keyword-only, so phrased-differently matches could be missing.
